1.label: Curative — equivalent to resection in its niche (RCT-level)

2.label: Curative-intent alternative — when resection / transplant / ablation not feasible

3.label: Bridge, downstage or conversion to surgery/LT, or adjunct to surgery

4.label: Second-line / palliative — disease control, survival extension

hcc|abl.head: First-line curative for solitary ≤2 cm; local control lower than resection above that

roles.when: Solitary ≤2 cm, Child-Pugh A (BCLC 0); at 2–3 cm or multinodular the equal survival depends on salvage being available
ev: SURF: OS/RFS NS but local recurrence 8.0 vs 15.8% favouring surgery; stopped at 302 of 600 planned
SURF final: 5-y OS 74.6 vs 70.4%, HR 0.96 — a failed superiority trial, not proven equivalence
Chen: OS NS, but per-protocol after 21% of the ablation arm crossed to resection; mean follow-up 28 mo
Vietti Violi: 2-y LTP 6 vs 12%, NS — a negative superiority trial at mean lesion 18 mm; BCLC 2026 now prefers microwave to 3–4 cm

roles.when: Recurrent HCC after resection; the apparent advantage of repeat resection above 3 cm or AFP >200 is an unplanned, unadjusted subgroup (50 patients) — hypothesis-generating
ev: OS NS (HR 1.26, 0.91–1.76), but local repeat recurrence 37.8 vs 21.7% and early repeat recurrence 40.3 vs 23.3% (both p=0.04) favour repeat resection; cx 7.3 vs 22.4%

roles.when: Solitary <7 cm or ≤3 nodules <3 cm: RFA + TACE (no size subgroup reported, so the 3–7 cm benefit is inferred)
ev: Peng: OS HR 0.53 vs RFA alone; single centre, 89% HBsAg+, half the cohort ≤3 cm, no resection arm

roles.when: Bridge to LT
ev: Sapisochin: dropout ≈ TACE/RFA, but explant necrosis 13 vs 49% and post-LT recurrence 23 vs 13% after SBRT

roles.when: Single ≤2 cm recurrent HCC where ablation is possible; above 2 cm the randomised advantage disappears and the retrospective data point the other way
ev: Xi: 2-y local PFS 92.7 vs 75.8%, but significant only ≤2 cm (HR 0.39); 2–5 cm NS (HR 0.58, p=0.31); PFS and OS identical
Wahl (retrospective): better freedom from local progression than RFA ≥2 cm — the opposite size pattern to Xi

roles.when: Bridge to LT
Perioperative: neoadjuvant RT for resectable HCC with PVTT; adjuvant RT after narrow-margin hepatectomy
ev: Wei: cancer-specific death HR 0.35; 11% lost their operation during the wait; 96% from one hospital
Bai: PFS and OS negative; recurrence shifted intrahepatic→extrahepatic (37.5 vs 14.6%); no surgery-alone arm, n=72

roles.when: Incomplete TACE; macrovascular invasion with systemic Rx
ev: TTP NS; LC ↑ vs DEB-TACE (post hoc)
RTOG 1112: missed its primary endpoint (1-sided p=0.06, HR 0.77, 90% CI 0.59–1.01); 15% never started sorafenib
Asan RCT: TACE+EBRT instead of sorafenib, not added to it; 91% of the sorafenib arm crossed over

roles.when: Painful hepatic tumour (HCC or metastases): single-fraction RT

hcc|y90.head: Segmentectomy = curative-intent; lobar = bridge or palliative

roles.when: Solitary ≤8 cm, unresectable / not ablatable; ablative segmental dosimetry
ev: LEGACY: ORR 88% by treated-zone mRECIST (46% by RECIST 1.1), 3-y OS 86.6% — retrospective, median 2.7 cm, 28% went on to transplant or resection

roles.when: Bridge / downstage to LT or resection; radiation lobectomy for FLR
Advanced / PVTT: no OS gain vs sorafenib in SARAH, SIRveNIB or SORAMIC; dosimetry is the open question
ev: DOSISPHERE-01: personalised vs standard dosimetry (not vs sorafenib) — ORR 71 vs 36%, OS 26.6 vs 10.7 mo, resection 36 vs 4%; phase 2, n=60, stopped early

hcc|tace.head: Standard for BCLC-B; main bridging / downstaging tool

roles.when: Ruptured HCC: TAE for haemostasis, then staged hepatectomy
ev: lower in-hospital mortality, better 1-/3-y OS vs emergency hepatectomy

roles.when: Adjuvant after resection, intermediate/high recurrence risk
ev: Wang (HBV): RFS ↑, 3-y OS 85.2 vs 77.4% — single centre, one reduced-dose cycle; EASL 2025 recommends against any adjuvant treatment

roles.when: Bridge / downstage to LT (UNOS-DS)
BCLC-B multinodular, Child-Pugh A–B7, no MVI; adding checkpoint therapy improves PFS only and stays inside a protocol
ev: EMERALD-1: PFS 15.0 vs 8.2 mo; OS interim not significant and withheld; haemorrhage doubled, 28% stopped for toxicity
LEAP-012: PFS 14.6 vs 10.0 mo; OS HR 0.80, p=0.087 against a 0.0012 threshold; grade 3+ 71 vs 32%

hcc|hai.head: Large / advanced HCC — mostly Asian RCTs

roles.when: Large (≥7 cm) unresectable without vascular invasion for Li 2021; Vp3–4 evidence is FOHAIC-1 and He
ev: Li: HAIC > cTACE, OS 23.1 vs 16.1 mo — excluded macrovascular invasion; conversion to resection 24 vs 12%

roles.when: Conversion in responders
Adjuvant HAIC-FOLFOX after resection for MVI
ev: Li adjuvant: DFS 20.3 vs 10.0 mo, OS NS — HAIC arm had arteriography the controls did not, so case-finding is asymmetric

roles.when: ≤3 tumours <3 cm with acoustic window; trial / registry

icca|abl.head: Small primary or recurrent iCCA when resection not chosen

roles.when: ≤3 cm, ≤3 nodules; unresectable / unfit, or intrahepatic recurrence; margin ≥5 mm

icca|sbrt.head: Ablative-dose RT for localized unresectable iCCA

roles.when: Liver-confined, unresectable, no nodal/EHD; BED >80 Gy
Unresectable, liver-confined
Downstaging to resection
Radiation lobectomy to grow FLR before resection
Unresectable liver-dominant, with systemic therapy
ev: mOS 15 mo; 28 vs 16 mo with systemic

icca|hai.head: Strongest regional data for unresectable liver-confined iCCA

roles.when: Unresectable, liver-confined ± regional nodes; FUDR pump + GemOx
ev: HAI+sys vs sys OS 30.8 vs 18.4 mo

roles.when: Conversion to resection
Trial only — pivotal trial enrolled HCC and metastases, not iCCA

crlm|abl.head: Curative intent; parity with resection not established

roles.when: ≤3 cm (≤10 lesions), resectable; margin >5 mm
ev: Stopped early; OS HR 1.05 (0.69–1.58) crosses the 1.30 margin — NI not shown; AEs 19 vs 46%

roles.when: Unresectable liver-only, with systemic therapy
1–3 lesions, ≤6 cm, not resectable or ablatable
Chemo-refractory or 2nd-line, liver-only / dominant
ev: PFS 8.0 vs 7.2, hPFS 9.1 vs 7.2 mo; OS NS

Not for 1st-line

ev: DEBIRI vs FOLFIRI OS 22 vs 15 mo
